canonical_project: LIXP / LIXPA Liberia Internet Exchange Point
notes: LTA official page confirms LIXP established 2015 as Liberia's first and only IXP; CCL provides LIXPA access; Telecel Liberia elected LIXPA chair (2025). PeeringDB locates LIXPA at CCL Building/Libtelco Compound, Lynch Street, Monrovia. IXP/interconnection node, not a standalone datacenter.
